title: Statement
description: One sentence the room should remember, large and thin, rising word by word. The words you mark in gold get a hairline that draws itself under them.

props.text: required, one sentence, up to about 16 words
props.gold: a word or a list of words from the text to colour gold
props.by: who said it or where it comes from, one short line
props.title: a small heading above instead of a kicker

example.text: The same motion becomes a slide you can still edit
